newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Alsons said a "trading buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Alsons said a "trading buy".

text.p: Urbancorp Securities Inc recommended on Thursday a "trading buy" on Alsons Consolidated Resources Inc saying the issue was undervalued.

"ACR currently is trading at a 1996 and 1997 price-earnings ratio (PER) of 18.5 times and 11.0 times respectively, offering a 19 percent discount to the holding sectors aggregated PER of 13.6 times for 1997," Urbancorp said in a study.
The issue slipped two centavos to 2.18 pesos by midsession.
It added that Alsons' ventures in power generation in the southern Philippines could help boost the company's earnings in the coming years.
